name: What is the difference between custom and semi-custom cabinets?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between custom and semi-custom cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom cabinets are built entirely from scratch to fit your kitchen's exact dimensions and specific design preferences, offering limitless options for materials, finishes, and configurations. Semi-custom cabinets are pre-manufactured in standard sizes but offer more flexibility than stock cabinets through various modifications, door styles, and finishes. Custom cabinets provide unparalleled personalization and space utilization, while semi-custom offers a balance of customization and cost-effectiveness.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom cabinets are built to exact specifications for unique designs, while semi-custom cabinets are standard sizes with more modification options.
